title: The Voice of the Qur'an and the Adhan: The First Sounds to Reach His Ears
summary: Hearing begins early, and what is repeated to a baby’s ear becomes familiar and beloved. Let your child hear a gentle recitation and the adhan in a soft voice—not for memorisation now, but to plant an early familiarity with the words of Allah that will bear fruit as he grows.
try_this: This week: Play a gentle recitation for a few minutes daily near your child during a calm time, and observe his tranquillity and contentment.
reflection_prompts: When does your child seem most at peace with the sound?
Have you made recitation part of his routine?

review_defects.english: Let your child hear ... Play ... observe ... Have you made
review_defects.why: The Arabic uses feminine singular imperatives and verb forms, directly addressing the mother. The English translation uses gender-neutral imperatives and pronouns, losing the warm, personal tone of the original.
